notes.title: May The 4th Be With You Sale!
notes.content:
[h2]Celebrate May the 4th with savings on LEGO(c) Star Wars (TM): The Skywalker Saga and LEGO(c) Star Wars (TM): The Force Awakens![/h2]


[h3]Get immersed in the entire Star Wars saga as you go on a legendary journey in a galaxy far, far away in LEGO(c) Star Wars (TM): The Skywalker Saga.[/h3]

[h3]
Relive the epic action from the blockbuster film with exclusive playable content that takes you on adventures between Star Wars (TM): Return of the Jedi and Star Wars (TM): The Force Awakens.[/h3]
